hook.en: The chance that a card is a king is 1 in 13. But if you are told it is a face card, the chance jumps to 1 in 3. Knowing something changes the probability.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ರಾಜ ಆಗುವ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ 13 ರಲ್ಲಿ 1. ಆದರೆ ಅದು ಮುಖ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿದರೆ 3 ರಲ್ಲಿ 1 ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಏನಾದರೂ ತಿಳಿದರೆ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Conditional probability and the multiplication theorem

body.en: The conditional probability of B given that A has occurred is $P(B|A) = P(A \cap B)/P(A)$, with $P(A) > 0$. Rearranged, this is the multiplication theorem: $P(A \cap B) = P(A)\,P(B|A) = P(B)\,P(A|B)$. A and B are independent if $P(B|A) = P(B)$, that is $P(A \cap B) = P(A)P(B)$. Then A′ and B′ are independent too.
body.kn: A ಸಂಭವಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿದಾಗ B ಯ ನಿಬಂಧಿತ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ P(B|A) = P(A ∩ B)/P(A). ಗುಣಾಕಾರ ಪ್ರಮೇಯ: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B|A). P(B|A) = P(B) ಆದರೆ A, B ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B).

say.en: Draw two cards without replacement. The first card is an ace with probability four by fifty-two.
Given the first was an ace, three aces remain among fifty-one cards.
Multiply along the branch: four by fifty-two times three by fifty-one is one by two hundred twenty-one.
If we put the first card back, the draws become independent and the answer is one by one sixty-nine.

homework.en: A bag has 4 white and 6 black balls. Two are drawn one by one without replacement. Find P(both white).

narration.en: Recap. P(B | A) = P(A ∩ B)/P(A). Multiplication theorem: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B | A). Independent: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B). P(at least one) = 1 − P(none).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. P(B | A) = P(A ∩ B)/P(A). ಗುಣಾಕಾರ ಪ್ರಮೇಯ: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B | A). ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B). ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಒಂದು = 1 − ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
